I added `discount_cents: int = 0` to `Invoice` in `src/billing/invoices.py`. I haven't run any tests.

- **Field placement:** I put it last, after `lines`. That way any code that builds an `Invoice` with positional arguments keeps working. It also follows the `_cents` naming of the other money fields.
- **`finalize()` ignores it:** `finalize()` still posts `subtotal_cents + tax_cents` to the ledger, so the discount has no effect on the amount posted. You asked only for the field. Changing the posted amount alters what goes to the external ledger. `finalize()` also isn't idempotent, so I left that call alone. If you want the discount applied, the change would be `subtotal_cents - discount_cents + tax_cents`. Tell me and I'll make it.
